method: Actual alpha>180 masks, all silhouettes uniformly compared at 270px authored body reference. Bands are opaque silhouette extents, not inferred bone metadata; hair/guard hands may contribute. Source head/torso opaque masks measured separately in their real authored axes. No runtime/source pixels or metadata changed.
headCrownMethod: Largest connected actual alpha>180 component in upper-head band above0.72floorheight, excluding disconnected raised/striking fists. Hair/crown remain part of visible head shape; no bone-reference claim.
